description: This source file implements operations related to git submodules within the larger project, including configuration management, status checks, updates, repository initialization, and various utilities for handling submodule git directories. It contains functions for managing submodule states, performing fetch and push operations, handling unmerged configurations, and relocating git directories of submodules. The code interfaces with other git components like refs, commits, and repository structures, indicating it is part of the core submodule management logic.

classes.name: struct changed_submodule_data
classes.description: Holds information about a submodule that has changed, including the superproject commit pointer, path, and new commit IDs.

classes.name: struct fetch_task
classes.description: Represents an ongoing or pending fetch operation for a submodule, containing relevant repository data, associated submodule, fetch arguments, and commits.

classes.name: struct submodule_parallel_fetch
classes.description: Holds state for parallel fetch operations over multiple submodules, including counters, argument vectors, repository info, lists of changed and seen submodules, and error reporting buffers.

classes.name: struct collect_changed_submodules_cb_data
classes.description: Stores context for collecting changed submodules during a revision walk, including repository pointer, list of changed submodules, and specific revision OID.
